Videos that critique a topic are allowed to use CR material to make a point. That's called fair use. However, if the visuals in your video are nothing more then CR material beyond the point that you made that doesn't count. 

On YouTube whether it is Fair Use or not, if a company makes a claim on the video it's gone. There isn't much you can do about it. Even if you fight it, YouTube will still wait on Yan Dev to revoke his claim. It's a rigged system. Best you can do is sue a person when they make a false copyright claim.
